title: Discover places worth coming back to.
description: Find restaurants near you and discover new options for your next outing.
demoNotice: Demo version: all restaurants and their information are fictional.
restaurantsDescription: Filter by cuisine and price level.

auth.title: My account
auth.notConfigured: User access is not configured yet. You can explore the sample restaurants.

errors.invalidCredentials: Unable to sign in. Check your email and password.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: This account has a pending confirmation. Check its status with the project administrator.
errors.weakPassword: The password does not meet security requirements. Use at least 8 characters.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again.
errors.network: Unable to connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Unable to complete the request. Try again; if the problem persists, check the service configuration.
errors.accountExists: An account already exists with that email. Try signing in.

nearby.title: Restaurants near you
nearby.description: Find up to five options within three kilometres. Filters apply when you press Search.
nearby.loading: Getting your location and searching for restaurants…
nearby.initial: Search using your browser location or choose a point on the map.
nearby.empty: No matches among the restaurants checked. Try different filters.
nearby.limit: The search filters up to twenty nearby candidates and displays at most five. It may not include every restaurant in the area.

errors.unsupported: Your browser does not support location access.
errors.denied: Allow location access in your browser and search again.
errors.location: We could not get your location. Check your device location settings and try again.
errors.timeout: The search took too long. Please try again.
errors.service: We could not retrieve restaurants. Please try again later.
errors.imprecise: Your browser location is too imprecise. Choose where to search on the map.
errors.signin: Sign in under My account to search for restaurants.
errors.rateLimit: The query limit for searches, lists and details was reached. Please try again later.

locationPicker.ready: The search will use your chosen point. You can adjust the filters.
locationPicker.help: Zoom and move the map to the area you want. You can also click a point. The cross marks the centre you will select; it is not your detected location.
locationPicker.unavailable: We could not load the map. Check your connection and Maps JavaScript API configuration, then reload the page.
locationPicker.missing: Map selection is not configured yet.
locationPicker.label: Map to choose the search location

restaurantMap.title: Restaurants on the map
restaurantMap.help: Numbers match the cards. Moving this map does not change the search location.
restaurantMap.unavailable: We could not display the map. You can use the cards and their Google Maps links.
restaurantMap.missing: The results map is not configured yet.
restaurantMap.noLocations: Coordinates are unavailable for these results.
restaurantMap.partial: Some restaurants have no coordinates and only appear in the cards.

lists.title: My lists
lists.help: Choose a list to view it. You can save restaurants from the search results.
lists.signin: Sign in to save restaurants and view your lists.
lists.service: We could not complete the request. Please try again.
lists.rateLimit: Query limit reached. Wait before opening the list again.
lists.empty: There are no restaurants on this list page.
lists.detailsUnavailable: We could not retrieve its current details. You can retry, move it or remove it from the list.
lists.moved: Restaurant moved to the other list.
lists.ratingSaved: Rating updated. Request new recommendations to apply the change.

history.title: Recommendation preferences
history.description: We use your searches and ratings to recommend restaurants. Here you can clear your search history; your ratings are kept.
history.confirm: Your search history will be deleted. This cannot be undone. Your lists and ratings will be kept.
history.signin: Sign in to clear your preferences.
history.service: We could not clear your preferences. Please try again.
history.saveFailed: We found results, but could not save this search to your history.
history.cleared: Your search history was cleared. New recommendations will still consider your ratings.

recommendations.help: Uses your selected location, searches and ratings instead of the form filters.
recommendations.noHistory: You have no searches or ratings yet. Showing nearby options without personalization.
recommendations.noPreference: There are not enough preferences to apply personalized filters. Showing nearby options.
recommendations.basedOn: Based on your searches and ratings: {{category}} · {{price}}. Results are ordered by distance.

ratings.title: My rating
ratings.unrated: You have not rated this restaurant yet.
ratings.help: Cuisine and budget are optional and reflect your experience. We use them with your score to recommend restaurants.

sharing.help: Anyone with the link can view this list, without your personal ratings. You can stop sharing at any time.
sharing.manualCopy: Select the link and copy it manually.
sharing.revoked: The list is no longer shared. The previous link no longer provides access.
sharing.service: We could not complete the request. Please try again.
sharing.signin: Sign in to manage your links.
sharing.notFound: The link is invalid or the list is no longer shared.
sharing.rateLimit: The query limit for this list was reached. Please try again later.
sharing.title: Shared list
sharing.readOnly: You can view the restaurants. This page is read-only.
